{{< include ../generated/studies/sparse-failure-analogue-diagnosis.md >}}

The diagnostic separates two actionable conditions. In 21 cases one component
already ranked the official positive in its top ten and equal reciprocal-rank
fusion vetoed it. In the other 54, neither component supplied a top-ten signal,
so reweighting those same lists cannot recover the positive without new
evidence.
